2021 · Paper · Current Biology 31:1417-1427.e6 · Sleep and dreams

Real-time dialogue between experimenters and dreamers during REM sleep

Konkoly et al.

Background Abstract only

Lucid dreamers in verified REM sleep can perceive questions, compute answers and reply with eye signals.

Primary source for ledger constraint C19 (sleep). Lucid dreamers in verified REM sleep can perceive questions, compute answers and reply with eye signals.

Results

Lucid dreamers in verified REM sleep can perceive questions, compute answers and reply with eye signals.

Limits

Konkoly 2021: 36 individuals; correct answers on 29 occasions across 6 of the participants (abstract). One multi-site paper; not yet independently replicated.

What we do with it

Evidence grade B in the constraint ledger; every theory on the scorecard is checked against it.

Touches our work: constraint_ledger, C19

Read the original (doi:10.1016/j.cub.2021.01.026). Source checked against the original.
